chapter: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

quests.title: The Lone Isle Named Night

dialogue.t: To think that these things happened... Milchi, and the person who left these notes behind... Everyone was so brave...
Rawr!
This is... This is that hibernating Saurian egg mentioned in those notes!
Are you trying to say that we should use the incubator to hatch it, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?
Rawr! Rawr!
Hmm, the egg does look like it's in good shape, and there's a manual for the incubator. Let's give it a try, shall we?

dialogue.sit: No clue if it'll work, but we can give it a go.
Nice, looks like our little buddy's about to meet a new friend!

dialogue.t: Rawr!
Whew... That sure was scary, with those monsters attacking out of nowhere like that. Good thing we're super strong, huh?

dialogue.sit: Guess I'll be counting on you next time, Paimon.
Hmph, is that all they've got?

dialogue.t: Huh? No no no, Paimon can't do that! Who'd want to fight those scary monsters, anyway!?
Rawr! Rawr!
Heh, looks like he's getting anxious already. Let's just find a way to hatch the egg first!

dialogue.sit:
The incubator is back in action...
All you need to do now is wait...
Hours pass, but nothing happens to the Saurian egg. It doesn't change at all...

dialogue.t: Err... Errh?
Weird. Nothing seems to have happened. Have we messed something up? Let's try again!

dialogue.sit: The egg itself might be the issue here.

You reboot the incubator as the instructions indicate...
But just as with your previous attempt, nothing happens to the Saurian egg...

dialogue.t: Aw... How long do we need to wait? Paimon's zoning out over here... Also, she's getting dizzy... and hungry...
Rrah... Grgh...
Huh!? Wait! Wait! It moved!

dialogue.sit: Let's wait a little longer, shall we?

After a long while...
The Saurian egg remains unchanged. No reaction, no sign of hatching.

dialogue.t: Still nothing... Could this incubator be broken? But its lights are on! Hmm. Is the problem with the egg, then?
...Hmm, waiting around doesn't seem like it'll help... Should we just take the egg with us?

dialogue.sit: No matter how hungry you get, don't even think about eating it, alright...

dialogue.t: Wraah! Wraah!
Come on, of course not! Also, don't give {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} any strange ideas!
Well, little fella, Paimon means that... if the problem's with the egg, it might never...
Rroo...
Don't be sad, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. There's nothing we can do about it...

dialogue.sit: Perhaps the environment here isn't suitable...
Or perhaps... the egg doesn't believe that this is the right time...

dialogue.t: Y'know, you're right! Maybe the egg isn't hatching because it thinks Natlan hasn't changed and isn't suited to be its home!
After all, it's been hiding inside here for so long, right? Of course it doesn't know what a wonderful place Natlan's become!
So, let's take it back and take good care of it! We'll tell it stories about beautiful landscapes, thrilling adventures, and all the wonderful people we've met — every single day!
In short, we'll let it know how great Natlan is now! Once it gets excited enough, it'll surely hatch on its own!
...Brwarh.
(test)破碎地板对话表现

quests.description: You’ve discovered a hidden chamber deep within the Isle of Night…
